parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: This is the domain name to which the interface is currently registered. {{empty}} indicates that the interface is currently not registered.

parameters.name: DomainNameIdentifier
parameters.description: The Domain Name Identifier, a shortened version of {{param|DomainName}}, denoted as DNI in {{bibref|G.9961|Section 8.6.11.2.1}}.

parameters.name: DomainId
parameters.description: The Domain Identifier of the domain to which the interface is registered, denoted as DOD in {{bibref|G.9961}}.

parameters.name: MACCycleDuration
parameters.description: The MAC cycle duration, as specified in {{bibref|G.9961|Clause 8.4}}. It is represented as multiples of {{units}}. In the case of power line, writing to this parameter has no effect and it reads back as 0, which is a special value indicating that the MAC cycle is synchronized with 2 AC cycles as defined in {{bibref|G.9961|Clause 8.6.3.1}}.

parameters.name: SCDeviceId
parameters.description: The DEVICE_ID of the Security Controller selected by the Domain Master.

parameters.name: SCMACAddress
parameters.description: The REGID of the Security Controller selected by the Domain Master.

parameters.name: ReregistrationTimePeriod
parameters.description: The time interval for periodic re-registration, as specified in {{bibref|G.9961|Clause 8.8.5.8}}. It is represented as multiples of {{units}}.

parameters.name: TopologyPeriodicInterval
parameters.description: The time interval that a node sends out the periodic topology update using TM_NodeTopologyChange.ind message, as specified in {{bibref|G.9961|Clause 8.8.5.8.1}}. It is represented as multiples of {{units}}. The special value 0 represents an infinite interval (i.e., no periodic topology update).

parameters.name: MinSupportedBandplan
parameters.description: Indicates the value of the minimal bandplan capability for a node that is allowed to register to the domain.

parameters.name: MaxSupportedBandplan
parameters.description: Indicates the value of the minimal bandplan capability for a node that is allowed to register to the domain.

object.description: This object specifies management parameters pertaining to the domain functionality (Domain Master function; see {{bibref|G.9961|Clause 8.6}}). The object exists only on G.hn interfaces that are currently the Domain Master, i.e. for which parameter {{param|#.IsDM}} is {{true}}.
